name: Set Up Full Floor Protection (Ceiling Spray)
intent: Roll out plastic sheeting across the entire floor before any ceiling spray work. Required for both spray and spray_backroll on ceilings because ceiling spray pattern projects more overspray downward than wall spray. Walls only need full cover for spray_backroll; ceilings need it for both spray methods.
doctrine: Same install rate (400 SF/hr) and same physical work as wall spray-backroll floor protection. Phase 1c will extract this as a shared MOD_SETUP_FLOOR_PROTECT_FULL referenced by both wall and ceiling scenarios. For Phase 1b we duplicate to keep each surface's diff math self-contained.
